item.title: Eastern North Pacific Tropical Weather Outlook
item.description:
000
ABPZ20 KNHC 071724
TWOEP

Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
1000 AM PST Sat Nov 7 2026

For the eastern and central North Pacific east of 180 longitude:

Active Systems:
The National Hurricane Center is issuing advisories on Tropical
Storm Pena, located several hundred miles south-southeast of the
Big Island of Hawaii.

Eastern East Pacific:
A broad area of low pressure is producing a large area of showers
and thunderstorms. Recent satellite wind data indicates this system
remains weak and disorganized. Some development is possible over
the next day or two, but unfavorable environmental conditions should
end formation chances early next week. Regardless of development,
this system is expected to bring areas of heavy rain to portions of
Central America through the weekend while it drifts northward.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.

&&
Public Advisories on Tropical Storm Pena are issued under
WMO header WTPA34 PHFO and under AWIPS header HFOTCPCP4.
Forecast/Advisories on Tropical Storm Pena are issued under
WMO header WTPA24 PHFO and under AWIPS header HFOTCMCP4.

$$
Forecaster Cangialosi
